title: NANPA authority for shard-A NPAs 801, 804, 810 and 813

data.notes: Current numbering materials identify 801 (Utah), 804 (Virginia), 810 (Michigan), and 813 (Florida) as in-service U.S. geographic NPAs. 807 is Ontario and excluded. Each included NPA satisfies integer(NPA) mod 3 == 0.

title: Salt Lake City Food Not Bombs 2025 current-status corroboration

data.notes: Salt Lake City identifies Food Not Bombs Salt Lake City as operating continuously since 1999 and funding ongoing free food recovery/distribution, deliveries and a community garden. Existing canonical org identity is reused.

Current first-party site identifies a Salt Lake City nonprofit collective committed to climate justice, collective liberation and nonviolent action; public contact lists an 801 telephone number and organizational email.

title: Richmond Food Not Bombs current public profile

data.publisher: Richmond, VA Food Not Bombs / Open Collective
data.notes: Current public organization profile says Richmond Food Not Bombs has operated since 1993, distributes cooked meals and groceries every Sunday, and self-describes as Solidarity Not Charity.

Current first-party site identifies MAD RVA / Richmond Mutual Aid as a solidarity network operating collectively, redistributing food, hygiene items and vital goods and running Meadowbridge Community Market and mini-grants.
